proposals.evidence: DEDR400 explicitly gives Kurux ālī woman, wife. Survey elli is proposed as a same-language vowel/gemination variant of this female kinship noun, preserving both recorded glosses and the source transcription; it is distinct from male āl under399. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5127 explicitly gives Kurux mōxnā eat foods other than cooked rice and Malto móqe eat meat/fruit. Survey mox/mokkʰas/moq retains these same-language verbs with ordinary finite endings and source aspiration notation; Kurux bread fits the primary food restriction. The article’s questioned Tamil comparison is not used. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
